allowed_changes: Wrap the exact gold-v6 render as a locked compound clip.
Add a source-led build before the locked core and, only if musically necessary, a bounded release after it.
Use the same-work section map and the same Frankie-led bar conduction law.
children.control_question: Does a longer source-led build make the existing gold-v6 payoff feel earned without weakening the winning core?
children.musical_gap: Gold-v6 proved the conductor for one short passage but did not establish a complete dramatic reason for the payoff.
prohibited_changes: No modification of the gold-v6 compound clip.

allowed_changes: Keep the gold-v6 core arrangement and Frankie timing locked.
Add at most two explicit ownership events using Four Seasons percussion, backing response, or a Måneskin fill already in custody.
Confine every addition or subtraction to declared masks with musical-function labels.
children.control_question: Do two deliberate handoffs make the records play off each other while preserving the coherence that beat literal co-play?
children.musical_gap: Gold-v6 established one-band coherence but the original commission also requires the two eras to answer and hand off parts.
prohibited_changes: No more than two handoff events.

allowed_changes: Keep every source clip, cue, duration map, pitch decision, and ownership decision identical to gold-v6.
Change only mix integration: dynamic spectral space around Frankie, low-end allocation, transient containment, shared room, and output gain.

estate_execution_order: Verify the exact gold-v6 owner-review receipt and freeze its score, render, bindings, and receipts under immutable custody.
Materialize gold-v7-production first because it changes no musical decision and can expose whether integration alone closes the remaining gap.
Materialize gold-v7-interplay second with at most two masked ownership events.
Materialize gold-v7-arc third by wrapping the exact gold-v6 render as a locked compound clip and extending only the dramatic arc.
Run machine admission and deduplication before preparing any owner files.
If at least two children qualify, prepare one blind frontier with gold-v6 and the qualified children; otherwise return a machine-failure ledger and no audition.

locked_invariants.rule: The exact Four Seasons lead-vocal performance remains continuous, unpitched, and unstretched through the inherited gold-v6 core.
The donor material must come from the corresponding Beggin section occurrence; generic cross-song alignment is prohibited.
The Måneskin band follows Frankie's measured bar durations through bounded bar-scale transforms; a global click or global vocal warp is prohibited.
Every new cut, transform, overlay, or automation move must serve the declared child strategy; unrelated edits are refused.
No generated or leaked duplicate lead vocal may coexist with Frankie.
Gold-v6 remains an unmodified audible control in the owner frontier and cannot be overwritten, relabeled as accepted, or replaced by a child.

required_for_every_child: All selected sources and transforms are accounted for in a PerformanceScore.
Two independent renders produce identical canonical PCM.
The exact gold-v6 owner-review receipt is verified before descent.
No source mutation, missing clip, silence, truncation, clipping, or undeclared fallback.
Frankie lead-vocal identity and authority are preserved.
Candidate audio is distinct from the incumbent and from the other admitted children.

gold-v7-arc: The embedded gold-v6 core is sample-identical to the protected incumbent.
The extension uses no more than two new sections and remains below 62 seconds.
gold-v7-interplay: No more than two handoff masks are present.
Decoded PCM outside the declared masks matches the incumbent exactly.
gold-v7-production: The clip and transform graph is structurally identical to gold-v6.
Only declared mix and master fields differ.

owner_frontier.duration_policy: Each comparison is duration-matched to its relevant incumbent window; the arc child is reviewed first as a whole passage and then on the inherited core.
